choose.when:
SELECT d.id AS document_id, d.document_type AS doc_type, 'ACTIVE' AS status, dv.mime_type AS mime_type, d.issued_on AS issued_date, NULL AS expires_date, dv.version_no AS latest_version, 'OWN' AS source, owner_user.name AS owner_name, NULL AS shared_by_name, wp.id AS workplace_id, wp.name AS workplace_name, wc.id AS work_case_id, worker_user.name AS worker_name, FALSE AS can_share, d.created_at AS created_at FROM documents d JOIN document_versions dv ON dv.document_id = d.id AND dv.version_type = 'SIGNED' AND dv.version_no = 2 JOIN work_contracts contract ON contract.work_case_id = d.work_case_id JOIN work_cases wc ON wc.id = d.work_case_id JOIN workplaces wp ON wp.id = wc.workplace_id JOIN users owner_user ON owner_user.id = d.owner_user_id JOIN users worker_user ON worker_user.id = contract.worker_id WHERE d.owner_user_id = #{userId} AND contract.employer_id = #{userId} AND d.document_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_CONTRACT' AND d.status = 'ACTIVE'
UNION ALL
SELECT d.id AS document_id, d.document_type AS doc_type, 'ACTIVE' AS status, dv.mime_type AS mime_type, d.issued_on AS issued_date, d.expires_on AS expires_date, dv.version_no AS latest_version, 'SHARED' AS source, document_owner.name AS owner_name, document_owner.name AS shared_by_name, wp.id AS workplace_id, wp.name AS workplace_name, wc.id AS work_case_id, document_owner.name AS worker_name, FALSE AS can_share, d.created_at AS created_at FROM document_shares share JOIN documents d ON d.id = share.document_id JOIN document_versions dv ON dv.document_id = d.id AND dv.version_type = 'ORIGINAL' AND dv.version_no = 1 JOIN work_cases wc ON wc.id = share.work_case_id JOIN workplaces wp ON wp.id = wc.workplace_id JOIN users document_owner ON document_owner.id = d.owner_user_id WHERE share.shared_with_user_id = #{userId} AND share.purpose = 'HEALTH_CERTIFICATE' AND share.status = 'ACTIVE' AND d.document_type = 'HEALTH_CERTIFICATE' AND d.status = 'ACTIVE' AND d.expires_on IS NOT NULL AND d.expires_on >= #{today} AND wc.worker_id = d.owner_user_id AND wc.employer_id = #{userId} AND wc.status IN ('ACCEPTED', 'READY', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND #{now} < wc.ends_at AND wp.owner_user_id = #{userId} AND wp.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT d.id AS document_id, d.document_type AS doc_type, CASE WHEN d.expires_on < #{today} THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END AS status, dv.mime_type AS mime_type, d.issued_on AS issued_date, d.expires_on AS expires_date, dv.version_no AS latest_version, 'OWN' AS source, document_owner.name AS owner_name, NULL AS shared_by_name, NULL AS workplace_id, NULL AS workplace_name, NULL AS work_case_id, NULL AS worker_name, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM work_cases share_case JOIN workplaces share_workplace ON share_workplace.id = share_case.workplace_id AND share_workplace.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE share_case.worker_id = #{userId} AND share_case.status IN ('ACCEPTED', 'READY') AND #{now} < share_case.ends_at AND d.expires_on >= #{today} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM document_shares existing_share WHERE existing_share.document_id = d.id AND existing_share.work_case_id = share_case.id AND existing_share.shared_with_user_id = share_case.employer_id AND existing_share.purpose = 'HEALTH_CERTIFICATE' AND existing_share.status = 'ACTIVE' ) ) AS can_share, d.created_at AS created_at FROM documents d JOIN document_versions dv ON dv.document_id = d.id AND dv.version_type = 'ORIGINAL' AND dv.version_no = 1 JOIN users document_owner ON document_owner.id = d.owner_user_id WHERE d.owner_user_id = #{userId} AND d.document_type = 'HEALTH_CERTIFICATE' AND d.status = 'ACTIVE' AND d.expires_on IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT d.id AS document_id, d.document_type AS doc_type, 'ACTIVE' AS status, dv.mime_type AS mime_type, d.issued_on AS issued_date, NULL AS expires_date, dv.version_no AS latest_version, 'SHARED' AS source, owner_user.name AS owner_name, owner_user.name AS shared_by_name, wp.id AS workplace_id, wp.name AS workplace_name, wc.id AS work_case_id, worker_user.name AS worker_name, FALSE AS can_share, d.created_at AS created_at FROM documents d JOIN document_versions dv ON dv.document_id = d.id AND dv.version_type = 'SIGNED' AND dv.version_no = 2 JOIN work_contracts contract ON contract.work_case_id = d.work_case_id JOIN work_cases wc ON wc.id = d.work_case_id JOIN workplaces wp ON wp.id = wc.workplace_id JOIN users owner_user ON owner_user.id = d.owner_user_id JOIN users worker_user ON worker_user.id = contract.worker_id WHERE contract.worker_id = #{userId} AND d.document_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_CONTRACT' AND d.status = 'ACTIVE'
choose.otherwise: SELECT NULL AS document_id, NULL AS doc_type, NULL AS status, NULL AS mime_type, NULL AS issued_date, NULL AS expires_date, NULL AS latest_version, NULL AS source, NULL AS owner_name, NULL AS shared_by_name, NULL AS workplace_id, NULL AS workplace_name, NULL AS work_case_id, NULL AS worker_name, FALSE AS can_share, NULL AS created_at WHERE FALSE

mapper.select: SELECT share.id AS share_id, wp.id AS workplace_id, wp.name AS workplace_name, wc.id AS work_case_id, CASE WHEN share.status = 'REVOKED' THEN 'REVOKED' WHEN share.status != 'ACTIVE' OR d.status != 'ACTIVE' OR d.expires_on IS NULL OR d.expires_on < #{today} OR wc.worker_id != d.owner_user_id OR wc.employer_id != share.shared_with_user_id OR wp.owner_user_id != share.shared_with_user_id OR wp.status != 'ACTIVE' OR wc.status NOT IN ('ACCEPTED', 'READY', 'IN_PROGRESS') OR #{now} >= wc.ends_at THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END AS status, share.created_at AS shared_at, share.revoked_at AS revoked_at, LEAST( wc.ends_at, TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(d.expires_on, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) ) AS effective_until FROM document_shares share JOIN documents d ON d.id = share.document_id JOIN work_cases wc ON wc.id = share.work_case_id JOIN workplaces wp ON wp.id = wc.workplace_id WHERE share.document_id = #{documentId} AND share.purpose = 'HEALTH_CERTIFICATE' ORDER BY share.created_at DESC, share.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM document_shares share JOIN documents d ON d.id = share.document_id JOIN work_cases wc ON wc.id = share.work_case_id JOIN workplaces wp ON wp.id = wc.workplace_id WHERE share.document_id = #{documentId} AND share.purpose = 'HEALTH_CERTIFICATE'
